description: Input is a Unicode string of at most256 Python code points. Return {runs:[{text:single-codepoint-string,count:positive-integer},...],length:integer}, with maximal consecutive identical-codepoint runs in original order and length equal to len(input). Do not casefold, normalize Unicode, treat grapheme clusters as single characters or sort. Whitespace/newline code points are ordinary characters. Empty string has empty runs and length0. Reject all non-strings and strings longer than256. Implement summarize(value) in totals.py returning the exact report dictionary; report.py reads one JSON value from stdin, prints that report and exits 0, or exits 2 for invalid JSON/input. summarize must raise ValueError for invalid input. Update test_totals.py with discriminating unittest tests. Change all three files. Use only the Python standard library. Only the existing three flat files may change.
